cloudBaseline.note: Codacy Cloud production snapshot (old config): 72 issues across 15 patterns, 12 tools enabled. Local broad-config baseline (714 issues) is the apples-to-apples BEFORE for this tuning run.

toolChanges.reason: Heuristic noise — flags every memcpy/printf regardless of safety (180 issues, all false positives on safe fixed-size copies and constant format strings). Buffer-overflow (CWE-120) and format-string (CWE-134) concerns remain covered by cppcheck's real data-flow analysis.
No OpenAPI/Swagger files in repo (only GitHub Actions workflows, coderabbit, plans YAML) and tool fails to load locally (InvocationError).

Cross-tool dedup — Bandit_B603 covers subprocess-without-shell concern.

Raised threshold 15→25 to match codebase cyclomatic complexity profile (up to 33).
